lines.text: Many learners say: I born in Izmir.
Better: I was born in Izmir.
Was born! She was born in 1995.

native.caption: “I born in Izmir.” mi diyorsun? 😅 Doğrusu “I was born in Izmir.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “was born”. Doğmak için was born denir. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: Turkish says “doğdum”, but English needs “was born”.
en.caption: Do you say “I born in Izmir.”? 😅 English needs was before born. The right sentence is “I was born in Izmir.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
